Maintenance window start: October 17, 2026, at 6:00 PM UTC
Maintenance window end: October 18, 2026, at 3:00 AM UTC

This deployment includes an updated website host and no solution update. This release includes security enhancements, customer-reported fixes, and performance updates. Release notes for this release can be viewed here.

How does this affect me?
During the update, the Portal Management page in the Power Platform admin center will be placed in a read-only state for a short period of time. Additionally, your Power Pages website(s) will be restarted once during this upgrade.

What action do I need to take?
Upgrade of the website(s) to the newest version will be applied automatically. No action is required.

Learn more about the Power Pages upgrade process

message.Title: Power Pages - Power Pages version 9.8.9.17 Production Release
